notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31995060/729274b6a290fd89a1f3ac763def8d244789bba1.jpg[/img]

Hunters, Miners and Alchemists!

Technical work on the new update to the game is completed!
Unfortunately, there is very little time left to participate in this tournament, that's why the win rewards for it are reduced, but on Thursday there will be held an additional short tournament in Egress! Get ready!

The current tournament will end tomorrow at noon Moscow time, hurry to join the battle and personally try out new update of the game! Due to the short duration of the current tournament, tomorrow the three best players will be awarded prizes that are a green, red and blue Steam card (11,5$, 4,6$ and 2,3$). Hurry up to participate and quickly win valuable prizes!

In the new game update:
Added:
1. A sight that greatly simplifies the throwing of grenades and weapons at enemies, as well as allowing more accurate shooting of guns
2. The ability to use the abilities of characters controlled by artificial intelligence.
3. Three types of rare consumable items that temporarily enchant weapons for damage with fire, poison or electricity.
4. A new consumable epic item that instantly restores 10% health (maximum 5 pcs. in inventory).
5. A new consumable rare item that gradually restores up to 30% health to everyone in a certain radius.
6. A new consumable rare item "throwing axe" that has a high chance of dropping an enemy.
7. Dances that can be used with a golden (most rare) weapon.

Rebalanced items:
1. "Skin" artifacts have been replaced with "bandage" artifacts with similar properties.
2. The weight of many items has been changed taking their power into account.
3. Increased the amount of expendable items falling from the chests.
4. Now the yellow chest is guaranteed to contain only 1-2 epic items.
5. Minor changes to the effectiveness of items
6. Changed some respawn points of teams.

Additionally changes to the effectiveness of the skills of heroes and cosmetic changes to display the health and damage of characters were added.

[h1]Closed Testing servers are running! This time we will test global progress and a new map![/h1]

[h1]Global Progress.[/h1]
You have to choose one of three sides - the Alchemy Academy, the League of Miners or the Hunter's Guild. Each side will have statistics of killings and points. Fighting, players will gain experience and levels. This will allow to open and use a new passive abilities [b](this mechanic is still in development and will be added later)[/b].
In addition, the choice of the side will also have a slight effect on the effectiveness of the items picked up during the game. As you may have noticed, many of the items were created by one of the sides (for example, poisonous artifacts by the Alchemy Academy, most of the defensive items by the League of Miners, etc.). Items created by your side will be used more efficiently.

Choose your side in a confrontation between two teams, destroy enemy's piñatas and protect yours, using new stationary cannons. Turn destroyed opponent's piñatas into your own, gather points and lead your team to glorious victories!

notes.title: The game has been updated. Changes in the game balance, fixed major technical problems.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995060/d71ac41fc4b0bd2e88d7b80b69d45b79dc62270f.jpg[/img]

- Main change: the server systems were completely overhauled. Players can now see which of the servers are filled and select where they want to connect.
- Characters and items were rebalanced. At the start of the match, characters are much weaker than before and importance of collecting items is much higher. Most valuable items are located farther from the top of the map. Damage of Molotov cocktails and grenades was changed.
- The map was changed as well, its top part was redone.
- Some optimization of net code and performance.
- Added ambient sounds.
- In a match you won't hear steps of defeated players (observing the game as spirits).
- Fixed a bug with counting players and representation of the final scores table.
- The water now rises faster and intervals between floods are shorter.
- Bloodkeeper's abilities were refined
- Multiple fixes here and there in problematic spots of the map.


Right now there are functioning 2 servers for EU and 2 for NA.

notes.title: The Closed Test began. What's next?
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31995060/cf9fd3c9883ca05958e1daeeb1864f555cac595d.jpg[/img]

Closed beta began on August 1st. Due to testing, we have identified many problems that our team is already working on to correct. Closed testing will continue! Unfortunately, in the near future we will not be able to accept new players. The game needs a lot of improvement before we can invite even more people.

Thanks to all those who test the game and report all the bugs and problems found. You can send all the information through our Discord channel:  https://discord.gg/xPgsFtM

The next patch will be published on the next week. Next, we plan to make updates with improvements and corrections about every two weeks.

Thank you for staying with us, despite all technical difficulties. We hope that together we can make Egress better!

notes.title: The start of closed testing is postponed for several hours
notes.notes:
We found several critical bugs that we can not run beta. The beta start will be postponed for about 1-2 hours. We will do our best to fix everything as soon as possible.

We apologize for the inconvenience.
